result.reason: The clause implements the preferred mutual aggregate cap, required uncapped carve-outs, and payment-obligation treatment, but it omits the required mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages. It therefore does not fully reach the preferred position. The revisions are otherwise targeted, preserve the underlying allocation of liability, and are professionally drafted, although measuring the fee period from the “event giving rise to the claim” differs slightly from the playbook’s claim-based formulation.
